title: Travelling
description: Name the things of a journey, and say where you are going.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for a journey
grammarNote: The nouns of a journey are ordinary nouns, and each one has its own gender.

explanation.summary: Travel words are the ones a learner needs on the first day abroad, and they are ordinary nouns with an article and a plural.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El pasaporte, el vuelo, el equipaje, el hotel y el conductor are masculine. La maleta, la aduana, la frontera y la reserva are feminine. El equipaje is the whole of it, and la maleta is one case. El conductor is the driver, and el andén is the platform at the station.

sections.heading: Where you are going
sections.body: You already know how to say where a place is and how to get there. Ir + a + place says where you are going: voy al hotel, voy a la aduana. En la frontera means at the border, and la reserva is the booking you made before you left.

examples.en: I am going to the hotel

examples.es: la maleta está en el equipaje
examples.en: the suitcase is in the luggage
I make the booking for November

items.note: Masculine: el andén. The accent marks the stress.

drills.meaning: the suitcase is on the floor
the passport is in the wallet
